system_health.method: Per lane: cadence / max(cadence, minutes since last SEND — a fresh SUBMITTED receipt counts, verification is a separate flag and never gates green. System = mean of lane scores x 100. Sources: verification-receipts.jsonl only (VERIFIED_PUBLISH verdicts with a post link, plus SUBMITTED send records). Same method as system_health.py, but receipts only: no newsroom.db supplement for Threads/Bluesky.
